name: Iqra Fund
mission: Iqra Fund provides preschool programs for communities to teach children ages four to six years old basic language, social, and formal learning skills to help them succeed in primary school.
programs: Access to Higher Education and Career Pathways
theoryOfChange: Iqra Fund has a published Theory of Change, which can be found on their 'Our Model' page. The theory states that 'if girls have an education, communities thrive, nations flourish, and overall planetary health improves'. This framework emphasizes that access to quality education for the first generation of girls in northern Pakistan will break the intergenerational cycle of poverty, lead to community development, and strengthen the overall health of the region. Their strategic priorities to achieve this include Community Engagement, Teacher Training & Development, Learning Environments, Student Success, and Access to Higher Education and Career Pathways.
